headline: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Damage Russian Petrochemical Plants in Tatarstan and Bryansk
summary: Ukrainian Armed Forces launched overnight drone strikes targeting Russian industrial facilities over 1,000 kilometers from the border. Targets included the Nizhnekamskneftekhim rubber complex and the TAIF-NK crude refinery in Tatarstan.
why: Nizhnekamskneftekhim and TAIF-NK are core components of Russia's downstream refining and chemical production base.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Successful long-range strikes on Russian refining towers reduce regional refined product output.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
